notes: Hermes runs a GENUINE autonomous self-prompting loop (/goal, hermes_cli/goals.py) whose iteration cap is real configuration — goals.max_turns in $HERMES_HOME/config.yaml — so this cell records the actual cap-hit rather than claudecode's /goal clear stand-in. With max_turns=2 the loop fires exactly two turns: the /goal kickoff enqueues the goal text itself, the judge returns continue and hermes self-prompts a second turn, then turns_used>=max_turns flips the goal to paused with no continuation prompt. The distinguishing assertion is iter2_start: it must go ready→working with NO driver-sent input between the two wait_turns, which is what makes this a self-prompting loop and not an externally-fed one. The termination assertion is cap_reached_dwell: after the second working→ready the session settles and DWELLS in ready with no further working transition — the loop stopped at its limit and did not stick in working or spuriously re-prompt. Presession form: hermes' sessions row is INSERTed ~2s after launch while the process exists from launch, so a transient proc-<PID> row is born first and reconciles into the store-keyed id; every post-birth phase anchors to the real session. No waiting is ever expected — the goal needs no tool approval.

PID bound to the store-keyed session
Loop start: /goal <unsatisfiable> sets the goal and immediately enqueues it, driving ready → working
First iteration ends on finish_reason='stop' → working → ready. The judge cannot mark the impossible goal done, so the loop continues; turns_used=1 of 2.

Second iteration begins with NO user input from the driver — hermes self-prompts its own continuation prompt back into the input queue. This is the assertion that distinguishes an autonomous loop from an externally-fed one.
Second iteration ends → working → ready. turns_used=2 reaches max_turns=2, so the goal flips to paused with no continuation prompt: this is the cap-hit.

Spec: state reaches ready even though the agent did not succeed, and does not stick in working. With the turn budget exhausted the loop stops self-prompting entirely — no further messages row is written — so the session dwells in ready for at least 15s with no post-cap working transition and never any waiting.
